function: Learned joint compression of RIS phase shifts into a B-bit control message and AP beamforming via unrolled WMMSE, maximizing weighted sum-rate (p. 2).
system: Narrowband downlink MU-MISO: AP with 4-antenna ULA, 3 single-antenna UEs, passive reflecting RIS 10x10 (100 elements), 180 kHz bandwidth, no carrier frequency stated (p. 2-3).
method: Model-based DL: autoencoder with trainable 1-bit quantizer plus unrolled one-iteration WMMSE built from FC networks; trained end-to-end by minimizing negative sum-rate (unsupervised, no labels) (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom simulator: geometric channels with 10 multipaths and own path-loss law; 64,000 training, 16,000 validation, 20,000 test samples; no 3GPP model, public dataset or measurements (p. 3-4).
test_conditions: Test set of 20,000 samples from the training distribution (M=4, K=3, N=100); sweeps over transmit power, B, N, CSI error; no unseen scenario tested (p. 4-5).
baselines: Non-learned: WMMSE-PI upper bound (100 iterations), random RIS phases. Learned: DQNN [6], ACFNet [7], linQ [15, 16], AQE without WMMSE updater (p. 4).
metrics: Achievable sum-rate (bps/Hz) versus transmit power, control bits, CSI error and N; number of parameters; normalized training and validation loss (p. 4-5).
complexity: Big-O per module, e.g. encoder approx. O(N^2 (64K+64M)), decoder O(2N^2+N Nc); Table I gives parameter counts, e.g. 16,539,458 at B=10 (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 3: "All channels are geometrically modelled with m = 10 multi-paths". Custom geometric simulator with its own path-loss law; no 3GPP TR 38.901 model, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 4: "We generate 64,000, 16,000, and 20,000 samples for training, validation, and testing, respectively." Test data is a held-out part of the same simulation; p. 5 Fig. 4 only sweeps CSI error, N and B, and no model trained in one condition is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 4: "Upper Bound: We use the WMMSE-PI algorithm [4] with 100 iterations" (non-learned, plus random phase shifts) and p. 4: "Benchmark 2 (ACFNet [7])" (earlier learned, also DQNN [6]); both compared on sum-rate, p. 5: "we compare the achievable sum-rate".
q4_support: p. 4: "In Table I we show the number of parameters of the considered models". Also p. 4: "The complexity is O(" with Big-O expressions for the encoder, decoder and beamformer-updater networks.
notes: Area 3: the learned method outputs the RIS phase-shift control message and the AP beamformer, with sum-rate as main metric; the compression acts on the phase-shift control message, not on CSI feedback. RIS is passive reflecting; the control link is assumed error-free. Page 2 text extraction is scrambled by the two-column layout; Table I and Figs. 3-4 were checked on the page images (pp. 4-5). q2 is 0 because Fig. 4a is a CSI-error sweep and Fig. 4b varies N and B with network sizes that depend on them, with no stated test of a trained model in unseen conditions.
